baseline_strengths: Refused to approve a user-controlled Keychain prompt.
Produced a scientific-metaphor report even for a no-change loop.
gaps_to_teach: Suggested releasing the active claim as blocked or letting it lapse instead of following the repository's ownership and heartbeat protocol through a temporary gate.
Did not require primary external technical sources when research is part of the wave.
Did not require a decomposed status-bearing implementation plan.
Allowed equivalent causal evidence instead of a strict RED-GREEN cycle for an implementation increment.
Used self-review instead of requiring an independent reviewer.
Did not require a structured checkpoint after every build, E2E, audit, or agent run.
Two of the three future collaboration options were operational duplicates.
